I've saved the 3분기 answers to `/work/answer.json`. Run the same way on 2분기, the method reproduces all 10 of your reference values exactly.

**3분기 결과**
| 항목 | 값 |
|---|---|
| a. 순매출 최고 세그먼트 | smb, 335,411,385원 |
| b. 결제 완료 주문이 있는 고객 수 | 247 |
| c. 순매출 최고 카테고리 | sw, 274,938,634원 |
| d. 순매출 최대 월 | 2025-09 |
| e. 환불액 합계 최대 고객 | u196@ex.com |
| f. 결제 완료 주문 2건 이상 고객 수 | 237 |
| g. 주문당 평균 순매출 | 709,074원 |
| h. 8월 대비 9월 증가율 | 18.0% |

Three interpretations were needed to hit the 2분기 reference values. They came from checking the data:
- **Time zone:** order times are stored in UTC. Treating them as Korean time (UTC+9) when assigning orders to quarters and months matched the reference (a, c, g and h). Using UTC gave different answers.
- **Customers:** 300 customer IDs share only 250 email addresses, so one person can have several IDs. I counted customers by email for b and f. Counting by ID gave 277 and 210 instead of 232 and 182 for 2분기.
- **Segment names:** the segment field has mixed case and stray spaces ("SMB", " consumer" and so on). I trimmed spaces and lowercased it before grouping.

Refunds were added up per order line before subtracting.

STATUS: DONE
